title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Home Organization Basics
summary: Start home organization basics this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Pick the worst room first
2. Empty, sort: keep/donate/trash
3. Clean the empty space
4. Assign zones by use
5. Contain with bins/baskets

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Home Organization Basics Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common home organization basics questions.
body:
Q: Where to start?
A: The room that stresses you most.

Q: Keep or toss?
A: Unused for a year + no strong reason = donate.

Q: Kids' stuff?
A: One bin per kid for keepsakes; rotate toys.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
